# ML Rust catalogue

Rust projects for machine learning: libraries on crates.io, and apps.

## How to read this site
Read the smallest file that answers the question.
- Choose a project for a job: open the job list below. Each line links one project.
- One project: https://ml-rust.github.io/projects/<slug>/llms.txt

## Jobs
- Machine learning: https://ml-rust.github.io/topics/ml/llms.txt
- Tensors: https://ml-rust.github.io/topics/tensors/llms.txt

## For scripts
- Every project and signal, over 8 MB. Do not load it into a model: https://ml-rust.github.io/data/catalogue.json
- What its fields mean: https://ml-rust.github.io/data/README.txt
- Tier rules: https://ml-rust.github.io/rules/
- Atom feed of changes: https://ml-rust.github.io/changes/feed.xml
- License of the data: CC-BY-4.0
